requirements.statement: Effective intent: WorkRequest gains append-only intent_events (ADD/CORRECT/CONFIRM/REJECT/SUPERSEDE) with id, subject, provenance, rationale, reference and replaces; legacy requests remain readable.
WorkSpec becomes the effective state with per-item status ACTIVE/REJECTED/SUPERSEDED/UNRESOLVED; no reverse Markdown parsing; legacy fields remain readable.

PortablePlan upgraded to frozen execution contract with frozen intent hash, tasks/deps, traceability, scope, effect policy, capabilities, budgets, concurrency, recovery, stop conditions and references; plan/prompt are renderers of one contract; no generation before explicit request.

`agent-rules handoff plan|prompt --output - --persist auto|never|always` emits one self-contained artifact; plan compile stays a compatibility alias; receivers with and without runtime are both supported in one copy.
Pre-handoff audit returns PASS/BLOCKED/NEEDS_USER over ten checkpoints with three independent gates and full effective-intent convergence.
TaskPacket gains machine-checkable execution policy: phases DISCOVER/PLAN/IMPLEMENT/VERIFY/REPAIR/CLOSE, scope, effects, capabilities, budgets, concurrency, proof, recovery, stop conditions.

Operator always selects host/model; selectProviderByEvidence removed from execution authority; approvedModels/approvedRouting migrated with compatibility reader; strong-planner/reviewer capability unverifiable returns NEEDS_USER.
MCP install profile gating with default none and convergent removal/disable/migrate/NEEDS_USER entry handling.
Host config never contains enabled agent-rules MCP entries by default; disabled descriptors or removal plus task-local overlay.
Task-scoped MCP activation with PID/process-tree receipts and full teardown; idle-zero guarantee (0 managed process/CPU/RAM/network without a task).
install/sync/verify/reconcile lifecycle fixes: install profile-scoped, sync once, verify read-only, reconcile exit codes reflect BLOCKED/NEEDS_USER, no out-of-task MCP network.
5fedu activates only via explicit domain_pack=5fedu marker; router telemetry stays internal.
Reference broker receipt drives the only 5fedu footer; no banner/template-checked/footer without a consumed receipt; BLOCKED/NEEDS_USER on inaccessible mandatory source; stale projection tests.
Versioned host-capability attestation and enforcement order native -> broker -> workspace transaction -> BLOCKED.
Mutating workers run in disposable worktree transactions; read-only direct only with proven sandbox.
Trajectory supervisor over heartbeat/resource governor with bounded reason receipts and serialized shared mutation.
No hard-coded Gemini/provider routing; PreToolUse deny/ask/force_ask; adapters probe host versions.
Artifact admission EPHEMERAL/CHECKPOINTED/COORDINATED/AUDITED; support pack optional; bounded worker context; temp helper lifecycle.
Compaction capability UNSUPPORTED when host lacks it; single active revision pointer.
agent-rules close with closure transaction, residue extraction, promotion, retirement, purge eligibility and cold archive.
All ten workflow cases pass.
Eval suites (handoff, artifact lifecycle, MCP, 5fedu, enforcement, schema migration) pass.
Verification gates pass without weakening verification.
Reinstall, release and branch/worktree cleanup per plan section 5 with receipts.

note: Owner-authorized new phase: North-Star vNext (on-demand MCP, deterministic 5fedu, portable one-copy harness). Supersedes adaptive-minimal-proof-testing pointer (baseline merged in main, acceptance COMPLETE). Single frozen contract is this plan; no default support directory.
